cases.memory_shape: One durable, typed preference with a source span and a separately addressable current value.
assertions: corrected value wins in a later conversation
old value is inspectable as superseded lineage
current response does not narrow a broad preference into a remembered sub-preference
cases.ade_contract: Supported for typed preference correction and revision provenance; semantic recall quality needs a live embedding route.
cases.hindsight_trial: Retain a user-scoped transcript, update the same document with a correction, then recall under the common memory budget with source facts/chunks recorded separately.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized retain/recall provider, deterministic user bank or strict user tag, and measured extraction plus recall latency.

cases.memory_shape: An explicit removal of a durable fact followed by an unrelated later conversation.
assertions: forget request is source-bound
removed value is absent from active retrieval and dialogue context
audit trail distinguishes forgotten from never stored
cases.ade_contract: Supported for explicit forget, active-status filtering, revision lineage, and source evidence; a provider-backed end-to-end replay is pending.
cases.hindsight_trial: Delete the source document or identified memory and prove the old value is absent from recall while deletion scope and retained unrelated content are inspected.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized Hindsight instance and a post-delete recall trace; document-level versus individual-memory deletion must be recorded.

cases.memory_shape: A time-bound concern, its follow-up, and an explicit resolved or expired state.
assertions: follow-up is relevant before resolution
resolved concern does not recur as current
source and lifecycle transition are inspectable
cases.ade_contract: Unsupported as a native fact type or lifecycle: current typed facts have no concern, expiry, or resolution model.
cases.hindsight_trial: Retain a timestamped transcript with explicit resolution and inspect whether recall distinguishes an active concern from historical context.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized temporal retain/recall run with source trace; no result may be inferred from timestamp documentation alone.

cases.memory_shape: A promise and conversation-visible event spanning user and assistant turns, without real-world co-presence.
assertions: promise can be followed up naturally
event provenance identifies transcript turns
reply never fabricates physical participation
cases.ade_contract: Unsupported as a typed native memory: reviewer evidence binds only the current user message and fact registry has no promise or shared-event type.
cases.hindsight_trial: Retain a role-labelled full transcript with stable document ID, then recall the promise and inspect returned source chunks before common ADE dialogue generation.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized extraction/recall run and human review of role attribution plus unsupported-experience negative cases.

cases.memory_shape: Two durable subjects with distractor facts and a second conversation for the same subject.
assertions: same-subject later conversation can access its fact
other subject is absent before generation
retrieval trace or query evidence proves the boundary
cases.ade_contract: Supported structurally: facts, embeddings, and search are subject-scoped; live semantic retrieval remains pending.
cases.hindsight_trial: Use one isolated bank per subject or an enforced strict user tag, retain distractors, and capture recall traces for both subjects.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized storage/recall run with explicit bank or tag configuration and adversarial cross-subject probes.

cases.memory_shape: Relevant current preference or concern beside old dog/travel distractors and already-mentioned callbacks.
assertions: relevant detail is retrieved when useful
distractors are omitted
previously used facts are not mechanically repeated
cases.ade_contract: Not met by current context selection: up to twelve recency-sorted active facts are inserted before semantic retrieval, so irrelevant/repeated callbacks are a context-selection risk.
cases.hindsight_trial: Recall against the same distractors at the common memory budget and measure ranked result relevance, then feed only the candidate result to the same ADE dialogue stage.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized retrieval and common dialogue-generation experiment; fixture or fake rankings do not establish semantic quality.

cases.memory_shape: A transcript-only exchange about a photo or event with no evidence of shared physical presence.
assertions: stored summary remains transcript-scoped
response does not claim seeing, visiting, or doing the event together
review record cites the source text
cases.ade_contract: Unsupported as a dedicated representation; existing facts can preserve user facts but not transcript events with a no-co-presence contract.
cases.hindsight_trial: Retain the role-labelled transcript and inspect recalled chunks/source facts before common dialogue generation; do not use reflect as the dialogue comparator.
cases.live_requirement: Authorized extraction/recall plus human semantic review of Chinese replies against the negative assertion.
